fusions.name: Reaping Arc
fusions.desc: Only strikes a target at or below 30% health. Deals 20 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Swath
fusions.desc: Holds 4 charges, one spent on each cut and one returned by each kill. Cuts a cone that deals 8 damage to everything caught in it.

fusions.name: Gleaner's Edge
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Late Harvest
fusions.desc: When you go too long without a critical hit, your critical hit chance rises by 30% for 6 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
